title: Battery v1 Specification Schema
description: Exhaustive field definitions for a Battery Digital Product Passport. Covers EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542, India AIS-156/AIS-038/BIS/EPR requirements, and PLI Phase II compliance.

chemistry.description: Battery chemistry — e.g. LFP, NMC, NCA, LCO, LTO, LMO, Sodium-Ion

carbon_footprint.description: Declared carbon footprint (legacy free-text). Use carbon_footprint_result for verified values.

country_of_origin.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of manufacture — e.g. IN, DE, CN

manufacturer_address.description: Physical address of the manufacturing facility (required for EU DPP)

certifications.description: List of safety and compliance certifications held by this batch

material_composition.description: Critical raw material percentages — mandatory for EU Battery Regulation Art. 8

cobalt_pct.description: Cobalt content as a percentage of cell mass

lithium_pct.description: Lithium content as a percentage of cell mass

nickel_pct.description: Nickel content as a percentage of cell mass

graphite_pct.description: Graphite (anode) content as a percentage of cell mass

manganese_pct.description: Manganese content as a percentage of cell mass

lead_pct.description: Lead content as a percentage of cell mass

recycled_cobalt_pct.description: Percentage of cobalt content sourced from recycled material (EU 2030 target: ≥16%)

recycled_lithium_pct.description: Percentage of lithium content sourced from recycled material (EU 2030 target: ≥6%)

recycled_nickel_pct.description: Percentage of nickel content sourced from recycled material (EU 2030 target: ≥6%)

recycled_lead_pct.description: Percentage of lead content sourced from recycled material (EU 2030/2035 target: ≥85%)

hazardous_substances.description: REACH/RoHS hazardous substance declarations — mandatory for EU DPP

lead_present.description: Whether the product contains lead above RoHS threshold (0.1%)

mercury_present.description: Whether the product contains mercury above RoHS threshold (0.1%)

cadmium_present.description: Whether the product contains cadmium above RoHS threshold (0.01%)

exemptions.description: Any RoHS exemptions claimed (Annex III/IV references)

expected_lifetime_cycles.description: Expected number of charge–discharge cycles at rated capacity (e.g. 1000, 3000)

recycled_content_pct.description: Overall recycled content percentage of the battery pack by mass

eu_representative.description: EU Authorized Representative name or company (required for non-EU manufacturers)

cell_source.description: India: Whether cells are imported or domestically manufactured — mandatory for AIS-156 and PLI

domestic_value_add.description: India PLI Phase II: Domestic Value Add percentage (≥50% required for PLI eligibility)

hsn_code.description: India: Harmonized System Nomenclature code (batteries fall under Chapter 8507 — e.g. 85076000)

bis_number.description: India: BIS R-Number for this batch (CRS IS 16046) — e.g. R-41001234

epr_number.description: India: EPR registration number for this batch (BWM Rules 2022) — e.g. B-29016/2024-25/CPCB

sale_price_inr.description: India PLI: Ex-factory sale price per unit in INR

import_cost_inr.description: India PLI: Import cost of components per unit in INR (for DVA calculation)
